notes_for_editor: Brief checked: the 420 m elevation and the May 14, 1997 registration match the NHLR. Height 94 ft is converted to 28.7 m. A 1981 survey note in the Wadena list says about 100 ft; the story reports the conflict. The blog cited in the brief (minnesotafiretower.blogspot.com, 2012) returned 404 and is not used. No source read names a specific fire the tower helped catch. Access: NPR (2021) describes one northern Minnesota tower as reserved for lookouts only; the article's Nimrod passage follows that line, so the story treats it as probably this tower, and no public visiting rules were found. No photos added. The NPR staffing claim is from 2021 and is the newest staffing evidence found.
